capacity_unit.description: Capacity unit used throughout the schedule comparison: CHAIR_HOUR.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

facts.rubric: Located APPT-24520 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: the stranded appointments are APPT-24520 to APPT-24523 for Reyes, Osei, Lindgren, and Tremblay; the earliest is APPT-24520 (MRN-470233).
facts.statement: CLIN-0006: the stranded appointments are APPT-24520 to APPT-24523 for Reyes, Osei, Lindgren, and Tremblay; the earliest is APPT-24520 (MRN-470233); the effective revision is v1.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective order and policy to establish 8 CHAIR_HOUR for chair-hours for four 2-hour natalizumab infusions (60 min infusion + 60 min observation each), with control date 2026-03-17.
facts.statement: The effective order and policy establish chair-hours for four 2-hour natalizumab infusions (60 min infusion + 60 min observation each) = 8 CHAIR_HOUR: four 60 + 60 minute infusions need 8 chair-hours, or 2 sessions when two infusions are sequenced per session. The control date is 2026-03-17 (latest acceptable date for the earliest pair (due 2026-03-10 + 7 days)).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 64 observed less 60 excluded to 4 supported CHAIR_HOUR for chair-hours on CHAIR-2 and CHAIR-3 between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-13.
facts.statement: CHAIR-2 and CHAIR-3 offer 64 chair-hours this week in gross; 60 are booked, protected, or blocked, leaving one free session (4 h) on 2026-03-11, 4 hours short; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-16 expedited readiness input for keep_chair_1_after_pump_return, then separately derived its 2026-03-23 operating outcome under free regular sessions on the working chairs without displacing protected blocks instead of treating a supplier promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Cascadia's confirmed April-cycle restock dates on Q-78010: Cascadia Q-78010 confirms the April-cycle restock standard 2026-03-18 and expedited 2026-03-13 (+USD 175); this week's doses are covered by 6 dispensable 7720 vials; a supplier confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied free sessions on CHAIR-2 and CHAIR-3, two infusions per session to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked sessions.
facts.statement: free sessions on CHAIR-2 and CHAIR-3, two infusions per session: the free sessions are CHAIR-3 PM 2026-03-11 and CHAIR-2 AM 2026-03-16; CHAIR-1 returns 2026-03-20 with its first free session 2026-03-23; protected and blocked sessions cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-CO-0106 only to rehome_series_to_open_sessions and APPT-24520; kept displace_protected_oncology_session outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-CO-0106 authorizes free regular sessions on CHAIR-2 and CHAIR-3 with two infusions per session; oncology blocks need the medical director and the calibration session is off limits. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize displace_protected_oncology_session.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected rehome_series_to_open_sessions: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies free regular sessions on the working chairs without displacing protected blocks.
facts.statement: the earliest pair must be dosed by 2026-03-17 and the last by 2026-03-19; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside free regular sessions on the working chairs without displacing protected blocks.

options.consequence: rehome series to open sessions pairs two infusions in CHAIR-3's free PM session on 2026-03-11 and the other two in CHAIR-2's free AM session on 2026-03-16, so the last patient is dosed 2026-03-16, inside every dosing window, at no incremental cost.
options.label: rehome_series_to_open_sessions: outcome 2026-03-16, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: keep chair 1 after pump return waits for CHAIR-1's first free session on 2026-03-23; it costs nothing but lands 6 days after the control date and pushes every patient past their 7-day window.
options.label: keep_chair_1_after_pump_return: outcome 2026-03-23, incremental cost USD 0, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: displace protected oncology session would finish all four by 2026-03-12 using CHAIR-2's protected AM block, 4 days earlier, but displacing an oncology protocol block needs the medical director, which AP-CO-0106 explicitly withholds.
options.label: displace_protected_oncology_session: outcome 2026-03-12, incremental cost USD 0, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

instruction: The pump on chair one failed inspection and biomed has it out until the twentieth, which strands the natalizumab patients booked on it this week. Neurology is firm that none of them can slip past a week beyond their due date. Figure out how much chair time those infusions need, what is honestly open on the other two chairs without touching the oncology blocks, and how far into next week the last of them lands. Move the first affected appointment to the session you settle on, and leave the scheduling lead a note that lays out the rest and any option that would need Dr. Hale.
